harry: Just saw a p95 jump for /v1/embeddings in na-east after deploy-8.0.0 (~2m ago). p95 ~1.0s now. dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/embeds/na-east

deploybot: deploybot: Alert: na-east embeddings p95=1000ms (>500ms). Autorevert policy active but blocked by change-window. Recommended: short pin or tenant reroute.

lina: oncall: traces show kv_cache miss bursts and bigger batches from tenant 'zephyr'. Might be tenant spike.

vijay: can we reroute that tenant to stable: `redwood route update --tenant zephyr --route embeddings --to release-7.9.3 --now` and apply a 30m regional pin?

ops-lead: approved. Harry/Lina run the commands. If metrics don't recover in 12m after pin, escalate to full regional rollback at 23:50 UTC.

harry: running: `redwood route update --tenant zephyr --route embeddings --to release-7.9.3 --now` then `redwood pin set --region na-east --route embeddings --version release-7.9.3 --duration 30m`

deploybot: deploybot: Tenant reroute applied; regional pin set by harry at 2026-04-15T14:12:40Z. Monitoring.

lina: pinned slice p95 dropped to ~160ms. Zephyr latency back at ~140ms. Opening INF-8882 with traces and the deploy diff.

ops-lead: comms: short CS blurb will go out. Owners: Harry (exec), Lina (trace & ticket), Vijay (rollback prep). Keep thread active until INF-8882 resolved.

harry: noted, will update.
